questions.q: The wind at 10 m is 7 m/s, open terrain. Roughly how much at 100 m?
options: 7 m/s — wind doesn't depend on height
about 5 m/s — wind is weaker higher up

questions.q: The report has no gusts. What do you assume?
options: A factor of 1.3–1.5 over the mean wind
No gusts — fly by the mean
Exactly +2 m/s on top of any wind
questions.explain: The mean wind is not the maximum; with no data, use 1.3–1.5.

questions.q: Which way do you fly first in the wind?
options: Direction doesn't affect the time to get back home
Into the wind, so you come back downwind
questions.explain: On the way back the battery is weaker — let the wind help.

questions.q: Site at 2000 m, +30 °C. Density altitude is roughly?
How does hover power change as density drops?
options: It drops in proportion to density
It doesn't change at the same mass

questions.q: Why does a cold LiPo “die” right after takeoff?
options: It has fewer cells in the cold
The flight controller measures wrong in the frost
The cold drains it in a minute
questions.explain: Voltage sag under load increases; warm batteries to 20–25 °C.

questions.q: Which conditions carry a risk of prop icing?
options: Dry frost at −25 °C with no clouds
Heat and strong wind in summer
questions.explain: Visible moisture and a temperature of roughly +2 to −10 °C.

questions.q: What does 27012G22KT mean in a METAR?
options: From the west at 12 knots, gusts 22 knots
questions.explain: Direction 270°, speed 12 knots, gusts 22 knots (≈ 6 and 11 m/s).
